summary: The change requires user verification for both WebAuthn ceremonies, keeps allowed authenticator selection compatible with platform passkeys and UV-capable security keys, and adds focused rejection and acceptance tests.

evidence: src/passport.ts lines 1016-1019 sets registration userVerification and authenticatorSelection.userVerification to required; lines 1101-1106 sets requireUserVerification to true.
src/passport.ts lines 1192-1195 requests required authentication userVerification; lines 1228-1233 sets requireUserVerification to true.
src/handler_test.ts lines 4023-4024 and 4144-4145 assert UV-less registration and authentication responses are rejected while UV-flagged responses succeed.
tests/bun_test.ts lines 1288-1301 and tests/passport_cutover_test.ts lines 474 and 535-543 add focused ceremony assertions and rejection checks.
